gold_note: Thyreophoran summary tree, root at the bottom, read by eye. Jinyunpelta joins the ankylosaurid branch through a line marked '?' below the Pinacosaurus-Euoplocephalus node; it is encoded as their sister. Each clade name labels the node above its tick: Thyreophoroidea (printed 'Scutellosaurus + Thyreophora [Thyreophoroidea]'), Thyreophora, Stegosauria, Ankylosauromorpha, Ankylosauria. 18 tips, 1 polytomies (4 children); 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
